Translated_Text: I don't know who gave me this name.

Primary_Text: Ge za da llo ernan ma dan.
Translated_Text: This thing is for measuring trees.

Primary_Text: Angde ubi gongoseyo, ubi ikop dägageyo mamam mätta da Meri erem de dibeyän audaban.
Translated_Text: When they returned, they saw that the red yam that Mary had planted disappeared.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gem eka de ttättle anggan, ge ddob lla da erem gomoenen amallo.
Translated_Text: I correct these words that some people mispronounce.

Primary_Text: Erem mätta de bongo moko eralle?
Translated_Text: Which yam do you like?

Primary_Text: dade eremde
Translated_Text: whichever

Primary_Text: Llɨg kälsre da ergodnen allan.
Translated_Text: The child is crawling.

Primary_Text: Kawam eria me dan oba ttängäm a duli.
Translated_Text: Their land is there, in the Kawam area.

Primary_Text: Bongo ngänäm dangelbne, ddone ikop dagne, erkoll a dangttawalle.
Translated_Text: You were looking for me and didn't see me; the dirty water hid me.

Primary_Text: Dirom de ngäna däbe darälgoe do llo da ulle da ero daeya.
Translated_Text: I dragged that cassowary to where that big tree was.

Primary_Text: Ero dan ma da?
Translated_Text: Where is the house?

Primary_Text: Essie nga wiya-o, bongo ngämo naerongg tater de.
Translated_Text: Essie, you come and start weaving my mat.

Primary_Text: Ddone aya umllang gogon ada erowattäm da ge za da gogezän.
Translated_Text: No one knew from where these things came out.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da erowattäm da ngänttägmäll allan?
Translated_Text: From where is this man arriving?

Primary_Text: Ge mälla da iba kame da erowede ibi allan.
Translated_Text: We (incl.) don't know where this woman is going.

Primary_Text: Bongo erowe ibi alle?
Translated_Text: Where are you going?

Primary_Text: Eso eka nägagan.
Translated_Text: He thanked him.

Primary_Text: Eso ulle.
Translated_Text: Thank you very much.

Primary_Text: Eso ulle bänene kandärmang e.
Translated_Text: Thank you for the gift.

Primary_Text: Eso ulle bänene ngämingg e.
Translated_Text: Thank you for the help.

Primary_Text: Census, ddob ako ttoen a dadegaeya, ewede deyaralle patrol a.
Translated_Text: There was the census, and also other things: that's why the patrol came.

Primary_Text: Ewede bongo bäne känyer yununin alle?
Translated_Text: Why are you sleeping by yourself?

Primary_Text: Obo gablle mättnan ma källän a ddäddäg ttoe dädär alle ngasngesatt daeya.
Translated_Text: The belt he wore around his waist was made from animal hide.

Primary_Text: ttongo gabma bo bin
Translated_Text: a white man's name

Primary_Text: Mätta de gaguma we dägagaeballo.
Translated_Text: They stored the yams in the yamhouse.

Primary_Text: Ubi Ende eka de gagägagäll däpanyallo.
Translated_Text: They spoke the Ende language poorly.

Primary_Text: Ge kollba da gagäll dan.
Translated_Text: This fish is bad.

Primary_Text: Da ngäna bol de ttang alle bäbädd, ngämo tupi di mɨnyi gagäll bäga.
Translated_Text: If I hit the ball with my hand, I will hurt my index finger.

Primary_Text: Ngämo giddoll a ngattong ai daeyag a be ngäna sisri gagäll ttam e azenan.
Translated_Text: My life was good at first, but now, I have entered a bad life.

Primary_Text: Panya dae ddone gagäll gogon.
Translated_Text: Only the pineapple did not go bad.

Primary_Text: Ngämo kameny me de gagäll gogon.
Translated_Text: He died during my absence.

Primary_Text: Ibim deyanglläbnegän gagäll kup att de.
Translated_Text: He brought us out of the depths of sin.

Primary_Text: Mäkat llɨgllɨgag a dan bäne gaguma me.
Translated_Text: There is a rat with babies in your yamhouse.

Primary_Text: Amo gall sisor da däbe?
Translated_Text: Whose new canoe is this?

Primary_Text: Eka tameny a bongo abo mudan, kälae ttatt gallab a mudan.
Translated_Text: You are not allowed to speak or open your jaw even a little.

Primary_Text: Abo ttatt de gallab a mudan.
Translated_Text: Don't you say a word.

Primary_Text: Ubi komlla apte walle gallgall e dängkällneneyo.
Translated_Text: The two of them climbed onto the other shore.

Primary_Text: Sämell a dizmollän gälgälag Geleli walle we guspullän a tämamae gomänddnegän.
Translated_Text: The pigs ran to the banks of the Sea of Galilee and fell in, and all of them drowned.

Primary_Text: Angde pos ganen a gottamänän ngäna sipel gog.
Translated_Text: When the post planting finished, I took a rest.

Primary_Text: Llan de ngämi däganyeya eka we.
Translated_Text: We tuned our ears for the sound.

Primary_Text: Nag wiya agezän.
Translated_Text: Friend, come out.

Primary_Text: Bogo ma ik atta gogezänän wälläng e dindugän.
Translated_Text: He got out from inside and ran into the bush.

Primary_Text: Kandärmang, yu da daollemae llamda da bälle gazenma da ddone mullae gogon.
Translated_Text: Sadly, the fire got closer to the old man and he didn't have a way he could escape.

Primary_Text: Yäbäd a mermer abal gogezänän.
Translated_Text: The sun came out, shining nicely.

Primary_Text: Kok a gazen allan.
Translated_Text: The moon is rising.

Primary_Text: Käsre tos de dägazen nyäng ik att de a batri käp de dazer.
Translated_Text: Then I took the torch out from the bag and put in the batteries.

Primary_Text: Aeya obom bigezänän?
Translated_Text: Who will come take him out?

Primary_Text: Alläp de era gazibra ttoe alle ttoe amallo.
Translated_Text: Drums are skinned with gazibra snake skin.

Primary_Text: Kottllam a bogo ada gongnomenynän adaka ddia da zäme ngattong agan, be bogo de amne me gotarnän llo gäba me.
Translated_Text: Turtle thought that Deer was already first, but he was in the middle sleeping in the shade of a tree.

Primary_Text: Ubi ttoenttoen gogneyo llo gäba me.
Translated_Text: They were telling stories in the shade.

Primary_Text: Män a kädkädag walle we mɨnyi bogbaebän.
Translated_Text: The girl will jump into the cold water.

Primary_Text: Llo gäbagäba de ikop dägagän.
Translated_Text: He saw a shady tree.

Primary_Text: Gäbänmällang dan.
Translated_Text: He is hopping.

Primary_Text: Män a gall att agäbänan.
Translated_Text: The girl jumped out of the canoe.

Primary_Text: Bogo gäbmäll allan.
Translated_Text: He is skipping.

Primary_Text: Ubi gäbmäll anggan.
Translated_Text: They are skipping.

Primary_Text: Bogo ttäle gäbmällgäbmäll ibi allan.
Translated_Text: He goes, skipping.

Primary_Text: Beyawaebe dägdene.
Translated_Text: Alone, he beat sago.

Primary_Text: Ngäna tri pos dae dägdeneg.
Translated_Text: I only sharpened three posts.

Primary_Text: Lla da gäddgädd e bobllabän.
Translated_Text: The men go to fight.

Primary_Text: Bongo sämell aba peyang gäddgädd alle.
Translated_Text: You are fighting with the pig.

Primary_Text: Ubi gogäddän.
Translated_Text: They fought.

Primary_Text: Mälla da sisri ag me kok de nägäddaeballo kollba tokong e.
Translated_Text: This morning, the women caught grasshopers for bait.

Primary_Text: Ngäma Dowabunang me gällall de ke ami dägäddaebeyo?
Translated_Text: Who cut our (excl.) pandanus leaves in Dowabunang?

Primary_Text: Tutu we dirngäneyo a ubi dägabllabän.
Translated_Text: She pulled her to land, and they stood.

Primary_Text: Dibaya kälepalle danyroene, angde dowae mäse diga, ddia da dam dindugän a dägabällän.
Translated_Text: I crept slowly towards it, and when I got close, the deer ran away and stood.

Primary_Text: Oba ulle binang a dägabälleyo ada ddia bo sawe ttang alle a kottllam bo ttätt ttang alle.
Translated_Text: Their big bosses stood like this: the deer's on the left hand side and the turtle's on the right hand side.

Primary_Text: Apapi da llo ttam me gägäb ine nanong dan.
Translated_Text: The butterfly drinks the dew on leaves.

Primary_Text: Däräng a ddia de diglibiyu Madura pate.
Translated_Text: The dogs chased the deer, steering it towards Madura.

Primary_Text: Ngäna käza de nägliban.
Translated_Text: I scared away the crocodile.

Primary_Text: Pa kom de dägläbaebeyo, tot do dangesaemeyo.
Translated_Text: They plucked the bird's feathers and made a mess there.

Primary_Text: Polle ma ik i angde gozenän, up wo gälbänanatt de ikop dägagän.
Translated_Text: When he went inside the fence, he saw the fallen ripe banana.

Primary_Text: Ngäma Dowabunang me gällall de ke ami dägäddaebeyo?
Translated_Text: Who cut our pandanus leaves at Dowabunang?

Primary_Text: Ngämo llimba da agällbänan.
Translated_Text: My fingernail broke.

Primary_Text: gämällang lla
Translated_Text: thief

Primary_Text: mälla gämäll
Translated_Text: adultery (lit. 'wife-stealing')

Primary_Text: Ngäna sana de gämäll agan bänene.
Translated_Text: I stole the sago from you.

Primary_Text: Ngäna sana de gämäll agan bablle.
Translated_Text: I stole the sago for you.

Primary_Text: Da bongo ddone otät de nonttog, bam mɨnyi gämäll nantägegän.
Translated_Text: If you do not give him food, he will steal from you.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bam danggebänängg.
Translated_Text: I made you stand.

Primary_Text: Ddia de ddone dagmoe bazu.
Translated_Text: Shooting the deer, I didn't miss.

Primary_Text: Ttongo eka nagmoeyan.
Translated_Text: I forgot to say one thing.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bam gämoe nallan.
Translated_Text: I am missing you.

Primary_Text: Ddob mälla da pane moepang de ikrol alle gällämnan amallo.
Translated_Text: Some women wash dirty pots with ash.

Primary_Text: Bogo pilatt de dängllämnegan.
Translated_Text: He washed the dishes.

Primary_Text: Da bongo källama atta angos, ttang anggälläm.
Translated_Text: If you come back from the toilet, wash your hands.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da dämen ma toko me inunin allan a mälläng gänggllam allan.
Translated_Text: This man is sleeping on a chair and snoring.

Primary_Text: Ngäna sɨmell de duduli dänggllädalle.
Translated_Text: I shoved the pig that way.

Primary_Text: Bogo gänya angttägan.
Translated_Text: He is coming here.

Primary_Text: Ngäna sisri gänya bäne peyang eka tameny allan.
Translated_Text: Now I am here talking with you.

Primary_Text: Bogo gänya nyongo me ibiag da.
Translated_Text: He often walks on this road.

Primary_Text: Da ngäna ddone yu bipellknegalle bablle, bongo ddone gänya mer yu mi kallkäll bongllaegalle.
Translated_Text: If I hadn't chopped this wood for you, you wouldn't have this nice fire to warm up by.

Primary_Text: Gänyaballe dallän do we.
Translated_Text: From here, he went there.

Primary_Text: Iba ge kollba da mullae dag, ibi gänyaballe ma we bängäsmäll.
Translated_Text: We (incl.) have enough fish; from here we shall return home.

Primary_Text: Ngämo eka da gänyaeben Ende eka da ge ngäna ere eka allan.
Translated_Text: The only language that I speak is this Ende language.

Primary_Text: Ede ngämo ttoenttoen llätt a gänyaeya.
Translated_Text: So here was the end of my story.

Primary_Text: Oba za da gänyag.
Translated_Text: Here are their things.

Primary_Text: Oba bin a gänyagaeya ada, Samson, Wawase, a Pedro.
Translated_Text: Here were their names: Samson, Wawase, and Pedro.

Primary_Text: Ge lla komlla da gänyageyo, ibnin allo.
Translated_Text: These two people here, they are going.

Primary_Text: Tätäm ubi komlla gänyagwaeya gonzämeyo.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, the two of them were here passing through.

Primary_Text: Mälla gänyamasäm dan.
Translated_Text: The woman is from here.

Primary_Text: Gänyamasäm a ddone mermer Ende eka de panypeny erallo.
Translated_Text: Here's why they aren't speaking Ende well.

Primary_Text: Gänyan obo sana da.
Translated_Text: Here is his sago.

Primary_Text: Bäne za de gänyaolle ikom.
Translated_Text: Bring your things over here.

Primary_Text: Eka sasapang a gänyaolle llɨtaem eran mälla walle.
Translated_Text: Various languages are arriving here along with women.

Primary_Text: Bongo gänyaollemae wiya.
Translated_Text: You come over here.

Primary_Text: Ngämo mäda gänyeri guddällän, gänyeri mälla de dällädän.
Translated_Text: My father came over here and got a local wife.

Primary_Text: Wendy, mamal gänyeriballe yaupe adawatta da mo da bäne peyang bottkamän.
Translated_Text: Wendy, jump quickly to this side in case the bridge breaks with you.

Primary_Text: Bongo wiya gänyerimae.
Translated_Text: You come over here.

Primary_Text: Kemu bo llabun a gänyme a Malläm me dadeg.
Translated_Text: Kemu has relatives here and in Malam.

Primary_Text: Tämamae lla da Ende eka de gänyme Llimoll me panypeny erallo.
Translated_Text: All people here in Limol speak Ende.

Primary_Text: Emaemae pa de dägäddaebeyo.
Translated_Text: They killed many different types of birds.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da sisri gäz e dan.
Translated_Text: This man is to be killed now.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da mälla da bom näbäddan.
Translated_Text: This man beat his wife.

Primary_Text: Bibi komllaebe gäddnan a mudageyo.
Translated_Text: You two, don't fight.

Primary_Text: Ge wätät a ddobae moko dan.
Translated_Text: This food is delicious.

Primary_Text: Ge obo mälla dan.
Translated_Text: This is his wife.

Primary_Text: Dagirne ge-e, dirom a daeya känyärdae gongttägän.
Translated_Text: I stayed there for a long time, the cassowary came up quietly.

Primary_Text: Gem de nɨpnae.
Translated_Text: You will turn this around.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gem eka de ttättle anggan.
Translated_Text: I correct these words.

Primary_Text: Ddia da däbe ddobae gi daeya.
Translated_Text: That deer was fatty.

Primary_Text: Oba giddoll makäp me ubi ttoen de mermerangae dangesnegneyo, wätät yagnen a,
Translated_Text: In their life, they did all things properly.

Primary_Text: Bäne giddoll a mɨnyi ada bogon ddobae llayaba za gämällangag.
Translated_Text: Your life will be like this, stealing things from people.

Primary_Text: Ttongo ause bo bin a Madima, Kinkin ttängäm me giddollag daeya.
Translated_Text: An old woman, her name is Madima, was living in Kinkin village.

Primary_Text: Män a Daru me dagirnän.
Translated_Text: The girl lived in Daru.

Primary_Text: Bongo polle ddäg me nagirne, ngäna do amne we balle.
Translated_Text: You stay outside the fence; I will go in the middle.

Primary_Text: Ende eka da ddone budabän be bagirnän enanae enanae.
Translated_Text: The Ende language will not be lost, but will remain forever.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da nyäng de giri alle papoe eran.
Translated_Text: This man is piercing the bag with a knife.

Primary_Text: Ngäna giri de dipirngän.
Translated_Text: I took out the knife.

Primary_Text: Nogat bom ubony a ere daeränggeyo, gudae enanae dɨnggɨgeyo.
Translated_Text: When bees started biting Nogat, they really attacked him.

Primary_Text: Aya ngämo up näglebän?
Translated_Text: Who took my banana?

Primary_Text: Net a gllaenen allan.
Translated_Text: The net is floating.

Primary_Text: Ngämi angde gogllaenalla, däbe za da dibeya ka ili därän.
Translated_Text: When we paddled, that thing almost disappeared.

Primary_Text: Ngäna mɨnyi gall de bogllae.
Translated_Text: I will paddle the canoe.

Primary_Text: Ngämi kili gogman, kili peyang gall de dagllaeya do Upiara dälltam.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) were so happy, with joy we paddled the canoe until we arrived at Upiara.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gall de mängamängall dagllae ddia koenmäll e, gall alle gumbiebmeny.
Translated_Text: I paddled the canoe quickly to chase the deer with the boat.

Primary_Text: Gällae de dängkamalle, dagllaealle dagllaealle.
Translated_Text: They started digging; they dug and dug.

Primary_Text: Yäbäd a mermerae gogllaewän.
Translated_Text: The sun shined nicely.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ttall ttoe de nägllewan.
Translated_Text: I removed the wallaby skin.

Primary_Text: Gällanggälla eran.
Translated_Text: He is swimming.

Primary_Text: Tätam ngämi bun i dängallaebeya, ako mutt i dingllaebeya.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, we (excl.) swam down the river and then back up the river.

Primary_Text: Däräng källa de ma ngätt att de baglloaebnalla.
Translated_Text: We will take dog poop out from the yards.

Primary_Text: Mälla da go bangesnegnän ine da eramae bizmollnän.
Translated_Text: The women will make drains so that the water will run.

Primary_Text: Godd ibim deyangesnegän.
Translated_Text: God created us (incl.).

Primary_Text: goeg kuddäll
Translated_Text: old garden

Primary_Text: Lla da goeg melem anggan.
Translated_Text: People do garden work.

Primary_Text: Lla llɨg a dandärmom mänmän abaene gogäle de.
Translated_Text: The boys heard the noise from the girls.

Primary_Text: Ma de gogo eran.
Translated_Text: He is building the house.

Primary_Text: Nogowallo.
Translated_Text: They built it.

Primary_Text: Ttongo täräp me ngäna ngämo ma gogo we gotäbane.
Translated_Text: One time, I planned to build my house.

Primary_Text: Abo bongo ttongo ma sisor de nogo.
Translated_Text: You must build a new house.

Primary_Text: Pa bo gogodd a malla ddäddäg ma dan.
Translated_Text: The bird's spleen is not edible.

Primary_Text: Ibi kumuddäga ine kutt de dogollaebaebeya.
Translated_Text: We (incl.) poured out three water buckets.

Primary_Text: Nogollaeb.
Translated_Text: [You] pour it.

Primary_Text: Gaem ai tater gollaeb de inen anggan.
Translated_Text: Gaem is weaving many good mats.

Primary_Text: Mänmän mängalae ine walle danggollaebägeyo.
Translated_Text: The girls quickly poured water on someone.

Primary_Text: wit gollob
Translated_Text: wheat hull

Primary_Text: Lla da päre abo gobällan kottllam bo gollob pallkepallke de dänglläbeyo.
Translated_Text: Then the people sadly went to the turtle and collected all the pieces of his shell.

Primary_Text: Llamda da gudae dallän polle we gozenän a up golloll me gotogolän.
Translated_Text: The old man went through the fence early in the morning and hid behind the banana tree.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gem eka de ttättle anggan, ge ddob lla da erem gomoenen amallo.
Translated_Text: I correct these words, which other people mispronounce.

Primary_Text: Bongo nalle, otät e nognen.
Translated_Text: You, go and cook the food.

Primary_Text: Llo mit de dugonaeballo.
Translated_Text: They burned the tree bases.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ine ttämttämang yu dägag a ngämo ttäle de dogonaeya.
Translated_Text: I boiled water and heated my leg.

Primary_Text: Buk nyäng a gonz alle inenatt a mer abal dan.
Translated_Text: Gonz reed is very good to weave book bags with.

Primary_Text: Gongglem daeben yäbäd ttänttämang me nane ma da.
Translated_Text: Immature coconuts are the best when drunk in the hot sun.

Primary_Text: greid siks me
Translated_Text: in grade six

Primary_Text: Wayati da duli ge ttängäm gudae ada enddäna gogon wayati dae gogon.
Translated_Text: There were so many watermelon there, this place was like a clearing of only watermelon.

Primary_Text: Gudae ag särem abal me ngäma ngämi otat de mängalae yu dägaebeya.
Translated_Text: In the darkness of early morning, we (excl.) quickly cooked our food.

Primary_Text: Bogo gudae abal angällbänan.
Translated_Text: He woke up very early in the morning.

Primary_Text: Ngäma ddob gudae att gagäll de dämbälaebnalla.
Translated_Text: Some of us (excl.) were remembering bad things from the past.

Primary_Text: gudae gudae täräp me
Translated_Text: long, long ago

Primary_Text: Komlla nag a dadegwaeya ami gudae deyagirneyo walle ddage menae me.
Translated_Text: There were two friends who used to live on the side of the stream.

Primary_Text: Dedme mɨnyi bibi obom ikop nägaeyo ada ingollang bogo alla umllang deyagnegän bibim gudae.
Translated_Text: You (pl.) will see him there, just like how he told you before.

Primary_Text: gudne lla
Translated_Text: old man

Primary_Text: Ge ma da gudne dan.
Translated_Text: This house is old.

Primary_Text: Däräng a gudne ulle gänyaolle ngäsangngäsang allan.
Translated_Text: The dog grew up here a long time ago and is always returning.

Primary_Text: Dedme bugimällämän lla da.
Translated_Text: People will be standing there.

Primary_Text: Bogo lla gul ulle de ikop dägagän.
Translated_Text: He saw the big mob of people.

Primary_Text: Ngämo yae a ngämo baba gogezäneyo Ende gul att.
Translated_Text: My mother and my father came from the Ende crowd.

Primary_Text: Ngäna Senti bom umllang däga ngämlle gulag e.
Translated_Text: I told Senti to accompany me.

Primary_Text: Mälla da kemibi kollba de nägäddallo gull alle.
Translated_Text: The women caught many fish with the net.

Primary_Text: Angde ngäna gull de ik i däga, käza da gull ik i gozenän.
Translated_Text: When I lifted the net up, the crocodile went inside it.

Primary_Text: Ngäna sɨmell de yagnen anggan, käm gullabgullab a.
Translated_Text: I'm looking for a pig, one with a fat belly.

Primary_Text: gullbe da walle
Translated_Text: couple

Primary_Text: Bäne gullbe da daden?
Translated_Text: Do you have a husband (lit. does your husband exist)?

Primary_Text: Gullbeda däban.
Translated_Text: That's her husband.

Primary_Text: ddia gullbe, sɨmell gullbe
Translated_Text: buck, boar

Primary_Text: Wel gullbe da gongttägän a mägda bo pite de däzinän.
Translated_Text: A big wind blew and lifted his mother's skirt.

Primary_Text: Ngämi yu dägaebnalla angde yogoll gullbe da dipliwän abo.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) were cooking them when a rainstorm started.

Primary_Text: Bäne yae auli gullbe peyang daeya?
Translated_Text: How many husbands does your mother have?

Primary_Text: Ge ekaklle ulle me, gullem sapasapang a dadeg.
Translated_Text: In this world, there are many kinds of snakes.

Primary_Text: Gullem llɨg a däbe agezänan tatuma me.
Translated_Text: A baby snake came out in that washing place.

Primary_Text: Mälla da gänyan, kaptte gullun alle obo bun di omllawan.
Translated_Text: The wife is here, her head is wrapped with old cloth.

Primary_Text: Angde Kwalde kuddäll agan, Kidarga ako mosen da bäne mik di nanggugan.
Translated_Text: When Kwalde died, Kidarga married his older brother's (i.e. Kwalde's) widow.

Primary_Text: Yesu lla yaba guwo watt gagäll anyke yuwog de däkällttanegnän.
Translated_Text: Jesus cast many evil spirits out from the hearts of men.

Primary_Text: Sali bo guwo watt dirom llɨg de ekaekong digezänän.
Translated_Text: Out of Sali's chest came a chirping cassowary chick.

Primary_Text: Bogo dadiweya gall guwo me dämenang dagirnän.
Translated_Text: He was sitting in the canoe.

Primary_Text: Bogo guzi de daittän.
Translated_Text: She caught a crayfish.

Primary_Text: Baba bo sana da gwaga käpang gogon kikib me.
Translated_Text: Dad's sago palm is already producing fruit.

Primary_Text: Llɨg kälekäle da sana gwaga käp alle gotongoenegnän.
Translated_Text: The children were playing with the sago fruit.

Primary_Text: Moses adawatta ge gwell de dadräbnegän bibra, bina tikop a llokollokott dag Adi bäne Mer Eka malaem e.
Translated_Text: Moses wrote these laws for you all, because your hearts are stubborn to obey God's gospel.

Primary_Text: Gwell eka de ngäna llɨtɨt eran.
Translated_Text: I'm telling a secret story.

Primary_Text: A atka gogon, [obo obo känae] obo känaebag ingäsmäll.
Translated_Text: And he said, "Come back tomorrow."

Primary_Text: Llɨg a ddone ako dingäsmällän Bundae bälle yagyag.
Translated_Text: The boys didn't return to Bundae.

Primary_Text: Däräng käsre dallän do ma we gogon, a täl pallkoll de diwenyän, käsre [adaka] adaka gänyaolle nagda Baet bo llan de täräpnan anggan.
Translated_Text: Dog then went to his house, and brought a piece of bamboo. Then, he cut his friend Cuscus's ears.

Primary_Text: Dindugän, do täl pallkoll dingällbällnän.
Translated_Text: He ran and got a piece of bamboo.

Primary_Text: Bogo nyäng de i eran.
Translated_Text: She is weaving the basket.

Primary_Text: Tater de aya diwän?
Translated_Text: Who wove the mat?

Primary_Text: Ngämo yae era lla ngänäm polle dinignän.
Translated_Text: My mother, she used to build sturdy fences like a man.

Primary_Text: Iba nag ttoen a alla ingoll utale ballän?
Translated_Text: How far will our friendship go?

Primary_Text: Bogo ibeny eran.
Translated_Text: He is planting.

Primary_Text: Biye de bongo ai dan ibik alle nibe.
Translated_Text: You can plant taro with the ibik stick.

Primary_Text: Ttängäm e gongttägeyo, misdae up daebegaeya ibebatta.
Translated_Text: They arrived at the garden; only bananas were planted there.

Primary_Text: Koe, ai dan ibi gänyme beyagernalla.
Translated_Text: Koe, it's good the two of us will be living here.

Primary_Text: Ngämi ttongo ebdo me Karama we gobllab inu wi.
Translated_Text: One day, we (excl.) went to Karama to sleep.

Primary_Text: Ngäna maket e ibi allan.
Translated_Text: I am going to the market.

Primary_Text: Mälla da gobällän ttängäm e melem e.
Translated_Text: The women went to the garden to work.

Primary_Text: Duli abäll bibi.
Translated_Text: You all go away.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da udu peyang ibiag dan.
Translated_Text: This man walks with a stick.

Primary_Text: Män kälsäre da dägabällän a ibnin de gongkamän.
Translated_Text: The little girl stood up and began to walk.

Primary_Text: Däräng aba mäda Kwalde bäne ibiatt de dongkollmälleyo.
Translated_Text: The dogs followed their owner Kwalde's footprints.

Primary_Text: Tätäm ibik a ddokddok gogon.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, the digging stick became blunt.

Primary_Text: Biye de bongo ai dan ibik alle nibe.
Translated_Text: You can plant taro with the ibik stick.

Primary_Text: Ai dan, käza da ddone ibim beyaddägän.
Translated_Text: It's alright, the crocodile won't bite us.

Primary_Text: Bongo nalle sana ma, ngäna tudi ma balle ibra kollba ma.
Translated_Text: You go for sago, and I will go fishing to get fish for us.

Primary_Text: Ubi mɨnyi mätta de bidaebneyo.
Translated_Text: They will dig up the yams and bring them over.

Primary_Text: Ada wayati da moko alle dädeyo.
Translated_Text: [You] pick watermelons as you please.

Primary_Text: Ubi ada ka bogo idd daeya.
Translated_Text: They thought she was a ghost.

Primary_Text: Angde iddob gogon, ngäna inu wi dalle.
Translated_Text: When night came, I went to sleep.

Primary_Text: Bäne moko daden ibi kollba ma sisiri beyareya, ako iddob abal e bonttägmällnalla.
Translated_Text: You want for us to go fishing now, so we will arrive late at night.

Primary_Text: Däbe ttall a iddob me guddällän.
Translated_Text: That wallaby arrived at night.

Primary_Text: Ttongdae mɨnyi awi alle do iddob amnong a ttongo ako iddob amnong alle do bädab bagirnän.
Translated_Text: One will stay from evening to midnight, and another will stay from midnight until dawn.

Primary_Text: Ttongo mälla da iddpo de nällpäganegnan.
Translated_Text: One woman was hanging the clothes.

Primary_Text: Obo iddpo da pällämpälläm a gombenmällnegnän.
Translated_Text: His clothes were white and shining.

Primary_Text: Tuk me gogäbaebän dowede ada gogon, ine ik gongkäbägän do igi abal.
Translated_Text: On top he jumped like this into the water, down to the very bottom.

Primary_Text: Igi me era däbe namllam.
Translated_Text: [You] grab the one on the bottom.

Primary_Text: Ge dädär de igi me era ekaklle da dakonenegän.
Translated_Text: These rocks underneath, the soil covered them.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da aeya ngämo imnealle beyarän, bogo mängallang abal dan, ngäna obo igiigi me dan.
Translated_Text: The man that will come after me, he is very powerful; I am beneath him.

Primary_Text: Bongo bäne igi pite de zäme amättalle?
Translated_Text: Did you already put on your underpants?

Primary_Text: Bogo dindugän do kukiny mama de ikop dägagän dibaeya däbe ik e gotärakän do gotägolän.
Translated_Text: He ran to a pile of tall grass that he saw, went inside, and hid there.

Primary_Text: Lama wa Mana ubi kandärmang me goensegäneyo adawatta Emi aoli kuddäll de ine ik me ikop dägagän.
Translated_Text: Lama and Mana were both feeling sorry because they saw that Emi almost died in the water.

Primary_Text: Bogo poper gogon, ma ik atta gogezänän wälläng e dindugän.
Translated_Text: He was shocked, got out from inside, and ran into the bush.

Primary_Text: Ngänäm ikikib da nallan.
Translated_Text: My head is spinning (lit. dizziness has gotten me).

Primary_Text: Yu ikllo da ttongo eka ngangema ttoen dan.
Translated_Text: Smoke is one way of sending a message.

Primary_Text: Ubi abo diba ikoll me ma we dängäsmällän.
Translated_Text: They then returned home from the incident.

Primary_Text: Bongo adawede eka dändärmeny agnalle, ikoll a nagan.
Translated_Text: You weren't listening, so it came back to bite you (lit. 'the trouble got you').

Primary_Text: Llamäg o mällause täräp me iba ikop a mɨnyi säremang bognegän.
Translated_Text: During old age, our (incl.) eyes will go dim.

Primary_Text: Lla da lla de ikop eran.
Translated_Text: A person sees a person.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ddia de ikop nägagan a nazuan.
Translated_Text: I saw a deer and shot it.

Primary_Text: Ikopag imne we.
Translated_Text: (You) look back.

Primary_Text: Omägag a obo nyäng e ikop gogon.
Translated_Text: The fortune-teller looked into her bag.

Primary_Text: Lla da däbe ikop dägneyo käza de.
Translated_Text: People were looking at that crocodile.

Primary_Text: Ge lla de ikop nägayaebeyo!
Translated_Text: (You all) look at these people!

Primary_Text: Llɨg a wa män a ubi ikop goddägneyo.
Translated_Text: The boy and the girl looked at each other.

Primary_Text: Masar era ngämim ikop deyaddägnän.
Translated_Text: Grandfather, he was watching us.

Primary_Text: kämbmeny ma ikop glas
Translated_Text: diving goggles

Primary_Text: Ubi ikopikop gogaebne.
Translated_Text: They were watching.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da obom ikoikop eran.
Translated_Text: This person is watching him.

Primary_Text: Steven a Kange, däräng de dällädeyo, pakos de dängkäneyo, ikop ku att de, däräng a ttam gogän.
Translated_Text: Steven and Kange grabbed the dog, pulled out the arrow from his pupil, and the dog lived.

Primary_Text: Eiz itrell a ikopmeny dan, lla bo mam me dan.
Translated_Text: HIV is invisible; it's in a person's blood.

Primary_Text: Ause da kollba we gopnaeyän a ine ik mi ikopmeny gogän.
Translated_Text: The woman turned into a fish and disappeared into the water.

Primary_Text: Ubi mɨnyi ikop särem atta buspullnän nyongo me, adawatta ma we ibima da utale abal dan.
Translated_Text: They will faint and fall on the road because going home is a very long journey.

Primary_Text: Känaebag, ngäna mɨnyi ikopse we beyar, ikopse ttamänatt me mɨnyi Upiara we bongos.
Translated_Text: Tomorrow, I am going to go pray, and after I finish praying, I will return to Upiara.

Primary_Text: Bongo mɨnyi mikutt mi iba ikopse ma de nälläk?
Translated_Text: Will you burn our (incl.) church in anger?

Primary_Text: Oba masamasar abaene ttoen de zuu aba ikopse ma ma me däntamenyaemneyo.
Translated_Text: They learned the ways of their ancestors in the Jewish temple.

Primary_Text: Däbe ikop songgorag lla da ada eka dägagän, "Ngämo moko da mermer ikopang e dan."
Translated_Text: That blind man said, "I wish to see properly."

Primary_Text: Llamda da up golloll me gotogolän a ikop su gognän känyertto ubira ikop e ami obo up de gämäll alle däglebneyo.
Translated_Text: The old man hid behind the banana tree and peeked quietly to see those who were stealing his banana.

Primary_Text: Ikrol da duwamänän.
Translated_Text: The ash dissipated.

Primary_Text: Ngämi ili ibi eran mondre ma dan.
Translated_Text: It's where we (excl.) go gardening.

Primary_Text: Da duli melem e ballän, ili Mospi o ili ballän, ede Ingglis eka de mɨnyi bäpanyän.
Translated_Text: If she goes away for work, in Port Moresby or wherever she goes, then she will speak English.

Primary_Text: Bongo ili kanyekanye gogäne?
Translated_Text: Where have you travelled to?

Primary_Text: Da ilibattäm lla da bogon, da ada Upiara watt, ngäna obom era ede mɨnyi pällämpälläm eka walle eka bäntameny.
Translated_Text: If the person is from elsewhere (i.e. non-Ende villages), then I would speak with him using English.

Primary_Text: Gall me bogo ngattong e, ngäna imne we, käza da amne me daeya.
Translated_Text: She was in front of the canoe, I was in the rear, and the crocodile was in the middle.

Primary_Text: Ddia da säre imne gogon, kottllam a ngattong gongttägän ttamän ma ngättma we.
Translated_Text: Sadly, Deer was behind; Turtle had arrived to the finish line first.

Primary_Text: Ddob lla da ami imne dongkollmällaemneyo lel gognegnän
Translated_Text: The others who were following in the back were scared.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bäne imne ballne.
Translated_Text: I will walk behind you.

Primary_Text: Ngäma mäda gagäll gogon, ngäma mäg ako imne gagäll gogon.
Translated_Text: Our (excl.) father passed away; later, our mother passed away too.

Primary_Text: Imne duwem ag, ngattong ttang de anggälläm.
Translated_Text: Eat after you wash your hands first.

Primary_Text: däbe imnealle
Translated_Text: after that

Primary_Text: kumuddäga pazi imnealle
Translated_Text: three years later

Primary_Text: Yäbäd imneimne gongbeabogän ddone dingmenän.
Translated_Text: Sun chased him from behind, but did not reach him.

Primary_Text: Ngämo nag zäme angttägan be ngäna mɨnyi imneimne bongttäg.
Translated_Text: My friend already arrived, but I will arrive later.

Primary_Text: Imnong e ubi dädmawän sipel e.
Translated_Text: After a while, they sat down to rest.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bibim imomdae de umllang anggan.
Translated_Text: I am telling you (pl.) truths.

Primary_Text: Bongo imomdae de ekalle.
Translated_Text: You are speaking the truth.

Primary_Text: Ge gänyan Ende imomdae eka dan.
Translated_Text: This here is the true Ende language.

Primary_Text: Ubi anykeanyke dae ikop dägageyo, ubi ddone imomdae up pätt de ikop dägageyo.
Translated_Text: They saw only the reflection; they did not see the actual banana plant.

Primary_Text: Sos me ada eka anggan, "Iba pätt a God bo imomdae giddoll ma dan."
Translated_Text: They say in church, "Our (incl.) bodies is where God truly resides."

Primary_Text: Bongo imomdae abal de ekalle ada, Adi da ttongdae dan.
Translated_Text: You are very right in saying that God is one.

Primary_Text: Bogo ddone komlla näkäpang bogon obo tikop me, be imomdae bägagän.
Translated_Text: He will not be doubtful (lit. two-minded) in his heart, but will believe it.

Primary_Text: Ngäma umllang dan bongo imomdae ttättlle panypenyang dan.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) know that you speak honestly.

Primary_Text: Imomdae ttoen peyang ikopse dae ada ingollang gagäll anyke de bäkällttanegän.
Translated_Text: Only with faith and prayer can the evil spirits be cast out.

Primary_Text: Tämamae ttoen a kuddukuddull dag oblle aeya imomdae ttoenang bognän.
Translated_Text: Everything is easy for he who may be a believer.

Primary_Text: Mosenda kaptte de dängllämnegnän a mänyanda bi komllaebe tupi imonzimonz gotngoeneyo walle ik mi.
Translated_Text: The oldest washed the clothes and the younger two played tag in the water.

Primary_Text: Bogo obom daimullgoeyän.
Translated_Text: She pushed him over.

Primary_Text: Ekaklle kok de mɨnyi enanae binamän.
Translated_Text: Earth will completely cover the moon (i.e. during a lunar eclipse).

Primary_Text: Ngäna sɨmell de dinam ekaklle we.
Translated_Text: I weighed the pig down to the ground.

Primary_Text: Mak ibim indraindrang umllang anggan ada Yesu era Adi bo llɨg aenen.
Translated_Text: Mark told us (incl.) clearly that Jesus is the Son of God.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ngämo tos indrang de dɨs.
Translated_Text: I put out my flashlight.

Primary_Text: Indrang a ngämo dowae me gogllaeyän.
Translated_Text: The light shined close to me.

Primary_Text: ttongo mer indrang ag
Translated_Text: one very bright morning

Primary_Text: Yäbäd a mɨnyi säremang bogon ebdo me a kok a ade mɨnyi ddone indrang bognän iddob me.
Translated_Text: The sun will be dark during the day and also, the moon will not be bright at night.

Primary_Text: Ngäna Adi lla bo mer de indrang eran.
Translated_Text: I am showing God's goodness.

Primary_Text: Aeya ge eka de indrang eran?
Translated_Text: Who is announcing this news?

Primary_Text: Bongo gagäll anyke, ngäna bam indugoeg nallan, agezän obo guwo watta.
Translated_Text: You evil spirit, I command you to come out of his heart.

Primary_Text: Mägda män de naindugoegan kaptte mättmätt e.
Translated_Text: The girl's mother commanded her to put on clothes.

Primary_Text: nge ine
Translated_Text: coconut water

Primary_Text: Ge ine da nanott dan.
Translated_Text: This water has been drunk.

Primary_Text: Bogo mängalae gogbaebän ine ik e oblle ngämingg e.
Translated_Text: She quickly jumped into the water to help him.

Primary_Text: Ubira mer näkäpngon a ddone dan adawatta ubi ine de nanen amallo.
Translated_Text: They don't have good judgment because they are drinking alcohol.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bänene ine kutt de yuwetyuwet yuwenyan.
Translated_Text: I borrowed your bucket.

Primary_Text: Bongo ine ma nalle oba bongo ine neyatan.
Translated_Text: You, go to the well and fetch water.

Primary_Text: Ngämi bam ge ddobae ddonddo nalla adawatta bäne ge mer abal inkäm dan.
Translated_Text: We are very proud of you because of your very nice voice.

Primary_Text: Obo inkäm a tubutubu dan.
Translated_Text: His neck is short.

Primary_Text: Pa bo inkäm tär a ddäddäg ma dan.
Translated_Text: A bird's throat is edible.

Primary_Text: Bogo Zon ine kämbägag bom inkätt danddugän.
Translated_Text: He sliced through the throat of John the Baptist.

Primary_Text: Ddapall a säremang gogon a deyainmollän.
Translated_Text: The sky got dark and overcast.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bäne mäkang lla de mängallmeny bägneg a bäne ttäle koll igiigi me bowattäll ubira inmoll e.
Translated_Text: I will make your enemies powerless and put them beneath your feet, vanquished.

Primary_Text: Ngämi tätäm era inngoeinngoe mo dae daupeya.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, we (excl.) crossed a shaky bridge.

Primary_Text: Eka tamenyatt me, ubi guinttemänggeyo a oba ma we deyareyo.
Translated_Text: After discussing, they parted ways and went to their own homes.

Primary_Text: Kottllam bom dätrameyo bem ulle we dainttemonggeyo.
Translated_Text: They carried the turtle to the ocean and set him free.

Primary_Text: Ngäna inunin allan.
Translated_Text: I am sleeping.

Primary_Text: Gänyme inuag!
Translated_Text: [You] sleep here!

Primary_Text: Bogo gotarnän pollon me.
Translated_Text: He was sleeping in a bush.

Primary_Text: Bogo inu atta angällbänan.
Translated_Text: He awoke from sleep.

Primary_Text: Bundae inu dan.
Translated_Text: Bundae is asleep.

Primary_Text: Dädme ngämi kumuddäga inu gogmam.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) stayed there three nights.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bam inuinu nallan.
Translated_Text: I'm making you sleepy.

Primary_Text: Llamäg a inu kuddäll daeya.
Translated_Text: The old man was fast asleep.

Primary_Text: Bongo nainungoenalleǃ
Translated_Text: You were shaking!

Primary_Text: Bogo ingellabang dan.
Translated_Text: He rises up in attention

Primary_Text: Ende walle inggoemeny amalla.
Translated_Text: We are making jokes in Ende.

Primary_Text: Ngäna Ingglis eka walle de eka bogne, buinggoemenyne.
Translated_Text: I will speak in English, making jokes.

Primary_Text: Bogo Adi bom inggoemeny eran.
Translated_Text: He is blaspheming God.

Primary_Text: Sabi tamenyang a inggoemeny eka de däpanyaemneyo.
Translated_Text: The teachers of the law were saying insults.

Primary_Text: Mälla da angde ikop dägagän, llɨg bo dowae e guinggolän.
Translated_Text: When the woman saw it, she moved closer to the boy.

Primary_Text: Bogo ingnenignen giddollag dan.
Translated_Text: He lives dancing about.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ingnenignenang ibi allan gänyaolle.
Translated_Text: I am coming this way dancing.

Primary_Text: Angde bongo bäne mälla bo ingoll papa eralle, bongo God bo ingoll papa eralle.
Translated_Text: When you hit your wife in the face, you are hitting God in the face.

Primary_Text: Ubi obo ingoll de iddpo alle dämllaeyo.
Translated_Text: They tied his face with cloth (i.e. they blindfolded him).

Primary_Text: Ttongo lla da agbänmällnan a ttongo lla da nindugan obo ingoll me.
Translated_Text: One man was jumping and another man ran in front of him.

Primary_Text: Ulle binang itrel peyang lla bo ingoll alle eka tameny a mudan.
Translated_Text: Don't converse in front of a very sick man.

Primary_Text: Bänz a pam nidol ingoll dagaeya.
Translated_Text: The mosquitoes were like needles.

Primary_Text: Täme da käza ingoll ddäddäg be ap me giddollag dan.
Translated_Text: The goanna is crocodile-like animal but it lives in the grassland.

Primary_Text: ingong täräp
Translated_Text: dance time

Primary_Text: Obo moko da ingong e dan.
Translated_Text: He wants to dance.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gänyaolle bengne.
Translated_Text: I will dance this way.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bam ingongang nallan.
Translated_Text: I am making you dance.

Primary_Text: Lla da ada dänyängnän menae me adawatta bogo ngattong abal gongttägän ttamän ma ngättma we.
Translated_Text: People were dancing like this on the sides because he got to the finish line first.

Primary_Text: Lla da ine ik atta guirängänän.
Translated_Text: The man came out from the water.

Primary_Text: Angde ngäna net de tuk i dirängän, käza da net ik i gozenän.
Translated_Text: When I lifted the net up, a crocodile went inside it.

Primary_Text: Mana ddone mullae gogon obo känyer, ede adawatta bogo Lama bälle wälle gogon, Emi bälle yirngän e.
Translated_Text: Mana wasn't able to herself, so she called for Lama to lift Emi out.

Primary_Text: Bogo ine me gongkäbägän, ede obo inggol iräpang agan.
Translated_Text: He dived into the water, so his face is dirty.

Primary_Text: Ngämlle ge kaptte da ibonmällang agnegan, ede ngänäm tatuma natram.
Translated_Text: These clothes got dirty on me, so [you] show me to the washing place.

Primary_Text: Kandärmang säre bablle pätt a ddone abal agan itrell atta.
Translated_Text: Sorry that the illness has made your body so unwell.

Primary_Text: Da ubi gullem de bänglläbaebneyo, ubi mɨnyi ddone buitrellnegnän.
Translated_Text: If they pick up the snakes, they won't get hurt.

Primary_Text: Yesu yuwog abal itrellang lla de ai dägnegnän.
Translated_Text: Jesus healed many sick men.

Primary_Text: Kaptte da ittananang da pätanan e.
Translated_Text: The clothes are hanging to dry.

Primary_Text: Mälla da net de mɨnyi bonyän baittallän.
Translated_Text: The woman will take the net and hang it.

Primary_Text: Molemoleg a llo ttam me itraenen anggan.
Translated_Text: Caterpillars hang from tree leaves.

Primary_Text: Ngäna Wagibo bo peyang buittall.
Translated_Text: I will stalk Wagibo.

Primary_Text: Angde toto gognän, Kila a Wala gall alle tudi ittaenen e deyareyo bem e.
Translated_Text: When evening came, Kila and Wala went to the sea to fish with the canoe.

Primary_Text: Bogo komlla guzi de deyaittän.
Translated_Text: She caught two crawfish.

Primary_Text: Ttongdae kollba da guittän.
Translated_Text: One fish was caught.

Primary_Text: ittma we zan
Translated_Text: ceremony in which a woman enters her husband's household

Primary_Text: Ngämaene gall a ada ka bopänayän, adawatta däbe za da ngämim deyangkollmällnän.
Translated_Text: We thought our (excl.) boat was going to capsize, because that thing was following us.

Primary_Text: Ddia da ttam agan adawatta ngäna bam ada ka bongo walle we aspunalle.
Translated_Text: The deer is alive because I thought that you fell into the water.

Primary_Text: Mer llo popo alle bongo darbänen alle, ada ka män duwar da bun mi popo de nowattällan.
Translated_Text: You decorate with nice tree flowers like a young girl puts flowers in her hair.

Primary_Text: Da klloklloe eka bäpanyeyo, ka Ende eka mɨnyi budabän.
Translated_Text: If they speak a mixed language, it seems the Ende language will be lost.

Primary_Text: E pazi me ka?
Translated_Text: In what year?

Primary_Text: Däbe tätämatt winy a ka tomowangtomowang moko allan.
Translated_Text: That honey from yesterday, it's tasting a bit bitter.

Primary_Text: ― Skul e angosan. ― Ka, ma me daden.
Translated_Text: ― He returned to school. ― No, he's at home.

Primary_Text: kab llatet att tär
Translated_Text: string made from twisted fiber

Primary_Text: Ddone aeya mullae gogalle oblle kab alle mällamälla we.
Translated_Text: No one was able to tie him up with a rope.

Primary_Text: gärep kabkab
Translated_Text: grapevine

Primary_Text: Gae da nge ingollae dan, be obo täma da kaekep ma dan.
Translated_Text: The gae palm is like coconut, but its husk is for chewing.

Primary_Text: Kaemne de ttang alle mällam a mudan, adawatta da bam ttang me naddägän.
Translated_Text: Don't hold bees with your hand, because they might sting you in the hand.

Primary_Text: Ngämi käza de net alle kaen eralla, mängallmeny agan zime käza da.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) wrap up the crocodile with the net; the crocodile is already weak.

Primary_Text: Kak säre zäme ause abal allan.
Translated_Text: Grandmother is already growing very old.

Primary_Text: Ddob kakab de dowattälleya ttongo ebdo we.
Translated_Text: They left some leftovers for another day.

Primary_Text: up wo kakab
Translated_Text: remaining ripe bananas

Primary_Text: Kok a wa piro da ddapall me kakakän giddollnen eran.
Translated_Text: The moon and stars are in space.

Primary_Text: nil kakakän
Translated_Text: loose nail

Primary_Text: Aenen ke ngämo mäg a?
Translated_Text: Who is my mother?

Primary_Text: Ngäma ma me nongg a kemibi abal dag.
Translated_Text: In my house, there are many geckos.

Primary_Text: Täne pittnen e keta da dagaya ottamänan.
Translated_Text: The stalk weaving has finished for the roof.

Primary_Text: Bogo mɨnyi yogoll de ketrop bägagän.
Translated_Text: She will stop the rain.

Primary_Text: Kili da daden.
Translated_Text: There is joy.

Primary_Text: Ngämi tämamae ddone ada kili gogmam.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) were all so happy.

Primary_Text: Ngäna bäne pate ddone kili allan.
Translated_Text: I am not happy with you.

Primary_Text: Bogo kili nägagan.
Translated_Text: He praised him.

Primary_Text: Obo ingoll a ddone kiliang agan.
Translated_Text: His face was not happy.

Primary_Text: Bogo mɨnyi ballän kilikili bägawän a ttang bänttepägän.
Translated_Text: He will go greet him and shake his hand.

Primary_Text: Däbe amom de kilikili nägnallo didri?
Translated_Text: Whom are they celebrating?

Primary_Text: Lla da bobällnän kilikili bägayaebneyo.
Translated_Text: People will go and celebrate.

Primary_Text: Meri ma we kilikiliangae dallän.
Translated_Text: Mary went home happily.

Primary_Text: Män kälsre da kilimeny agan.
Translated_Text: The little girl was sad.

Primary_Text: Bogo kilimeny gongäsän ma we.
Translated_Text: He went home unhappy.

Primary_Text: Bogo kilimeny nägagan.
Translated_Text: He insulted him.

Primary_Text: llo kip
Translated_Text: treetop

Primary_Text: Ngäna kɨllɨll di näddägan.
Translated_Text: I ate the killill snake.

Primary_Text: Auma däkällallo.
Translated_Text: They dig a grave.

Primary_Text: Gottamänän dibaballe kup di däkällneg a pos de däganeg.
Translated_Text: I finished, and then I dug the holes and put the posts in.

Primary_Text: Ubi goklloeyän Malläm ttängäm e.
Translated_Text: They gathered in Malam village.

Primary_Text: Chairman a obo melem a ada dan ge, lla de baklloenegnän eka tameny e.
Translated_Text: This is the chairman's job: he will gather the people for discussions.

Primary_Text: Ngämi eka de klloklloe panynen eralla.
Translated_Text: We are speaking mixing languages.

Primary_Text: Däräng dedme dinduag a ada gogon, wel kllomokllomoll dallän.
Translated_Text: Dog went running like this; he went downwind.

Primary_Text: ekaklle kodor
Translated_Text: plot of land

Primary_Text: Alla ubira sana kodor de basiaemeya?
Translated_Text: Can you give them a piece of sago?

Primary_Text: Ngäna llowam atta koen allan.
Translated_Text: I'm turning back due to fatigue.

Primary_Text: Bogo obom nängkoenmällan.
Translated_Text: He chased him.

Primary_Text: Ttongo täräp me llɨg kälekäle da gotäbanegän pa koenmäll e.
Translated_Text: One time, little boys planned to chase birds.

Primary_Text: Dadabi, mäsemäse llɨg a dongkoenmällaemneyo.
Translated_Text: The boys chased them naked.

Primary_Text: Lla da poura de nängkoenmällnegan.
Translated_Text: The man chased four chickens.

Primary_Text: Ddob sana gudne da koepangkoepang mokowang dag.
Translated_Text: Some old pieces of sago taste sour.

Primary_Text: Kok ekaklle de nganaenen eran.
Translated_Text: The moon spins around Earth.

Primary_Text: Ada gongnomenyne, ada ka ttongdae kok me daeya sukul a.
Translated_Text: I used to think that school was one month long.

Primary_Text: Mälla da sisri ag me kok de nägäddaeballo kollba tokong e.
Translated_Text: This morning, the women caught grasshoppers for fishing bait.

Primary_Text: Ngäna nge de kokllo eran.
Translated_Text: I'm scraping a coconut.

Primary_Text: Lla ulle da bandrabandrog bun akllonan.
Translated_Text: The big man was scratching his head while dancing.

Primary_Text: Kokngal e ibi täräp a eran yogoll täräp me dan.
Translated_Text: The time to go kokngal hunting is when it's rainy.

Primary_Text: Mätta koko da dade de nganae eran.
Translated_Text: The yam shoot is wrapping around the yam stick.

Primary_Text: Bogo ddäddäg de dokonggän oblle.
Translated_Text: He cut the meat for her.

Primary_Text: Ddia koko we ngäna llɨg di dokom.
Translated_Text: I took the boys to butcher the deer.

Primary_Text: Ge lla da nae de kokop eran.
Translated_Text: This man is peeling a sweet potato.

Primary_Text: Ttongo lla ulle da up o de näkopnan.
Translated_Text: A big man peeled a ripe banana.

Primary_Text: Nge kokowang a ibeny ma dan a ddob otnan ma dag.
Translated_Text: Some sprouted cocounts are for planting and others are for eating.

Primary_Text: Kokta da näbdaban.
Translated_Text: Moonlight is dawning.

Primary_Text: Kokta da indrang abal bogon.
Translated_Text: Moon shines so bright.

Primary_Text: Ubi mɨnyi kok tärangg me bazärnän ge wik me.
Translated_Text: They will be fasting this week.

Primary_Text: Ngäna gall e godagal, ine dokto.
Translated_Text: I got in the canoe and bailed the water out.

Primary_Text: ttang, ttang koll
Translated_Text: hand, palm

Primary_Text: Ngäna ma de dakollam.
Translated_Text: I stood the house up.

Primary_Text: Bäne kollba mu da auli dan?
Translated_Text: How much for the fish?

Primary_Text: Ngämo kollba mu da ttongo ttang lläpät dan.
Translated_Text: My fish is five kina.

Primary_Text: Kollba da tämamae dadrowän a be kottllam aebe ttam dagirnän.
Translated_Text: The fish all died but the turtle lived on.

Primary_Text: Bogo komlla kollba ulle de deyaittän.
Translated_Text: He caught two big fish.

Primary_Text: Sɨmell de enanae dukollädnegän pakos alle.
Translated_Text: He shot the pig straight through with the arrow.

Primary_Text: kollmällang e ebdo
Translated_Text: the following day

Primary_Text: Llɨg a mänmän de dongkollmällaemeyo.
Translated_Text: The boys followed the girls.

Primary_Text: Abo bongo mamamamall ngämim yangkollmällneg.
Translated_Text: You must follow us quickly.

Primary_Text: Lama ngämo kollmällang dan.
Translated_Text: Lama is the second child after me (lit. Lama's following me).

Primary_Text: Yesu duwem gognän obo kolmällang aba peyang.
Translated_Text: Jesus ate with his disciples.

Primary_Text: Ngämo kollmos ttam de nänddämän kuddäll ngättma we.
Translated_Text: It sunk my spirit to a place of death.

Primary_Text: Pakätt de llo ngoeang me dukullwenyallo.
Translated_Text: They hung the robe on the tree branch.

Primary_Text: bun kom, ttatt kom, mätta kom
Translated_Text: hair on head, beard, yam root hair

Primary_Text: Bogo ansi gogon a kom a pädrällag gognegän.
Translated_Text: He sneezed and the feathers flew.

Primary_Text: Mänyanda bi komllaebe ade tatu de gongkameyo.
Translated_Text: The younger two also started to wash.

Primary_Text: Bogo komllakomlla panypenyang deya ada Tame eka da wa Ende eka da.
Translated_Text: She spoke both Taeme and Ende languages.

Primary_Text: Komlla we nge da ngäna notan.
Translated_Text: This is the second coconut I ate today.

Primary_Text: Maryanne bom komo da näddägan.
Translated_Text: Maryanne was bit by a centipede.

Primary_Text: Grace ngänäm gull de dangkomonggän.
Translated_Text: Grace had me bring the net.

Primary_Text: Bong obo pope sɨmell midd de dangkomonggän.
Translated_Text: Bong brought the pork for his uncle.

Primary_Text: Ttall a obo za de dangkämonggän.
Translated_Text: The wallaby took her thing.

Primary_Text: Obo ma da duli kona me dan.
Translated_Text: His house is over there, on the corner.

Primary_Text: Ngäna sisri Llimoll me giddollnen allan Basido kona me.
Translated_Text: I am now living in Limol, in the Basido district.

Primary_Text: Yäbäd de ddapall käkan da dakonewän.
Translated_Text: Clouds covered the sun.

Primary_Text: Däbe män a konakone alle gokonewän.
Translated_Text: That girl covered up with a blanket.

Primary_Text: Ge ause da konkonang daeya.
Translated_Text: This old woman was crazy.

Primary_Text: Ngäna konkon allan.
Translated_Text: I'm getting mad.

Primary_Text: Ngämo yae konkonang gogon.
Translated_Text: My mother became mentally ill.

Primary_Text: Ngäna konkonang dan, ngämo kame dan bina eka da.
Translated_Text: I am ignorant; I don't know your (pl.) language.

Primary_Text: ine konkon me
Translated_Text: drunk

Primary_Text: Ine da ngänäm gagäll konkonang dagän.
Translated_Text: The drink made me really drunk.

Primary_Text: Llimollang a kopae därängmeny e Wim e abällan.
Translated_Text: Limol people went to Wim to trade.

Primary_Text: Ngängälatt dädär a mänyi tutu atta bolldaeyän kopek e.
Translated_Text: A round rock will roll from the hill to the valley.

Primary_Text: källama kopek
Translated_Text: toilet (lit. 'hole for pooping')

Primary_Text: ttang kotang peyang duwem
Translated_Text: eating with dirty hands

Primary_Text: Ngäna sisri kaptte kotang de gällämnan anggan.
Translated_Text: I'm cleaning the dirty clothes now.

Primary_Text: Lla da kote gottkamän.
Translated_Text: The man hung his head.

Primary_Text: gagäll kotkot anyke
Translated_Text: bad, unclean spirit

Primary_Text: Ngämo umllang dan bongo aenen, bongo Adi bo Kotmeny dan!
Translated_Text: I know who you are; you are God's pure one!

Primary_Text: Kottllam a ttongo källäm me dazernän.
Translated_Text: The turtles were living in a pond.

Primary_Text: nyongo ku me
Translated_Text: in the middle of the road

Primary_Text: Ddia da dukunegalle inu atta.
Translated_Text: The deer woke up.

Primary_Text: Masar ine kube de ngämo nangesan.
Translated_Text: Grandfather made me a water bucket.

Primary_Text: Mätta da kuddällkuddäll bognegän.
Translated_Text: The yams will become soft.

Primary_Text: Orpmang eka da kuddäkuddäll a era ngäna ai dan bondär.
Translated_Text: Wipi language is easy; I can understand it.

Primary_Text: Kuddällkuddäll dan baob wätät e.
Translated_Text: It's easy to eat waterlily.

Primary_Text: Gagäll dan lla da bem e buspunän kuddäll e.
Translated_Text: It is bad for a man to throw himself into the ocean to his death.

Primary_Text: Gullem a kuddäll agan.
Translated_Text: The snake died.

Primary_Text: sɨmell kuddäll
Translated_Text: dead pig

Primary_Text: kuddäll pätt
Translated_Text: dead body

Primary_Text: ma kuddäll, ttängäm kuddäll
Translated_Text: abandoned house, abandoned garden

Primary_Text: Kuddäll ttam ngäna dindug.
Translated_Text: I ran for my life.

Primary_Text: Ubi kuddäll ttam gotongoenegnän.
Translated_Text: They were laughing to death.

Primary_Text: Ubi deagerneyo ttongo kui me.
Translated_Text: They (two) lived on an island.

Primary_Text: Llɨg kälekäle, towall e ibnin a mudag, kuibiag a amom bäddägän.
Translated_Text: Children, do not walk in the grass; Papuan black snacks will bite anyone.

Primary_Text: Obo ma ud de kuimang dägagän.
Translated_Text: She knocked on his door.

Primary_Text: kuki ttoen
Translated_Text: trick

Primary_Text: kukiang keriso
Translated_Text: false messiah

Primary_Text: Bogo gongnamän ada mälla da obom era kuki dägagän.
Translated_Text: He realized that the woman deceived him.

Primary_Text: Ddob kukiang lla da mɨnyi bälltaemnän.
Translated_Text: Other deceiving men will be coming.

Primary_Text: Ai dan God ngänäm märal bagän da kuki allan.
Translated_Text: I swear to God I'm not lying (lit. God can curse me if I'm lying).

Primary_Text: Ubi sapasapang kuki eka de däpanyaemeyo Yesu bo pallall.
Translated_Text: They told various lies about Jesus.

Primary_Text: Kutt a kukollang ekaklle me guspullän a mermerae mängallang kukollang däpäddän.
Translated_Text: The seed fell to the fertile ground and sprouted vibrantly.

Primary_Text: Ubi tätäm nge kukrub doklloaebeyo a nge dädär peyang gongkänemenynegnän.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, they scratched water-filled coconuts and ate them with dry coconut.

Primary_Text: Pamker a mätta de kul bägayaebneyo.
Translated_Text: They will be smashing the yams and pumpkins together.

Primary_Text: Kullkull a dallän llamda pate.
Translated_Text: The grassfire moved towards the old man.

Primary_Text: Ngäna deyarne kullkull att dae.
Translated_Text: I was returning to the burnt grass.

Primary_Text: Ttongo däräng a kullkullat enddäna me pollpoll dängkamän.
Translated_Text: A dog started the bark in the burnt-up clearing.

Primary_Text: Da ttongo kantri me lla da bompallängkmenynegän obaoba komlla kullum e a bogäddeyo obaoba, däbe kantri da mɨnyi ddone bakällmewän.
Translated_Text: If in a country, the people divide themselves into two groups and fight each other, that country will not survive.

Primary_Text: Mätta bo kum a angttägan matu ik dae.
Translated_Text: The base of the yam comes up through the ground.

Primary_Text: Bogo kumattkumatt gongosän.
Translated_Text: He turned and went back.

Primary_Text: Llamda da kumiye agan.
Translated_Text: The old man coughed.

Primary_Text: Ag mullaemullae kumuddäga täräp pauro eka watt me.
Translated_Text: Every morning, I wake up after the third rooster crow.

Primary_Text: Nikol angde walle menae e nallan, ddone ada kollba nukuaemallo.
Translated_Text: When Nikol went to the side of the river, many fish scattered away.

Primary_Text: Ttongo lla da kunur däm kutt de ekaklle me bibewän.
Translated_Text: A man will plant the corn kernels in the ground.

Primary_Text: Da bam kungge da naddägän, bongo mɨnyi ttattlle ampug.
Translated_Text: If a spider bites you, you will be very ill.

Primary_Text: Ngäna ngämo män kälsäre de umllang dägag, ada ibi sisri mɨnyi kup di bäklleya.
Translated_Text: I told my little girl that we are going to dig a hole now.

Primary_Text: Ine da bodo dan kup mi.
Translated_Text: The well is full of water.

Primary_Text: Obo ma duli dan kup mi.
Translated_Text: His house is there in the valley.

Primary_Text: Kut a ddone bogon.
Translated_Text: They aren't rainclouds.

Primary_Text: ddäg kutt
Translated_Text: backbone

Primary_Text: Lepresi da kutt ngämnanang itrell dan.
Translated_Text: Leprosy is a disease that can affect the bones.

Primary_Text: Yokon kutt di dibewän.
Translated_Text: Yokon plants the seeds.

Primary_Text: ine kutt, pane kutt
Translated_Text: water bucket, pan

Primary_Text: Ikopse agaebne adawede ge ttoen a ddone kutt tataemang kallkällang abal täräp me bongesän.
Translated_Text: [You all] pray that this thing doesn't happen at a shiveringly cold time.

Primary_Text: Ge däräng a kwaratang abal dan.
Translated_Text: This dog is very thin.

Primary_Text: Angde ubi bibim kwatt e yatraemneyo, mudag näkäp ttomoenen a.
Translated_Text: When they take you all to court, do not worry.

Primary_Text: Yesu bom dämllaeyo a diba imnealle Paelet pate dätrameyo kwatt e.
Translated_Text: They tied up Jesus and after that, they took him to Pilate in court.

Primary_Text: Yäbäd angde ttänttämang abal gogon, däbe lla da obo labalaba de dängkänän ttänttäm atta.
Translated_Text: When the sun got very hot, that man took off his lap-lap because of the heat.

Primary_Text: laemnenatt otät
Translated_Text: rolled food, wrap

Primary_Text: Bogo ttäkäll de dälemnegän.
Translated_Text: She rolled up balls of yam and coconut.

Primary_Text: Ubira tämamae lla yaba läponang gogon.
Translated_Text: All of them were amazed.

Primary_Text: Ubi daläponeyo.
Translated_Text: They were amazed.

Primary_Text: Ubi dindugeyo lel me.
Translated_Text: They ran in fear.

Primary_Text: Lla da sɨmell de lel dägagän.
Translated_Text: The man feared the pig.

Primary_Text: Ge kungge da bäne lel ma za dan.
Translated_Text: This spider is what you fear.

Primary_Text: Bogo lel allan ngämo mit me.
Translated_Text: She is ashamed because of me.

Primary_Text: Baba da mɨnyi obom lel bägagän.
Translated_Text: Father will be ashamed of him.

Primary_Text: Bogo deya lelang llo toko e gogäbänän.
Translated_Text: He was so scared he jumped into the treetop.

Primary_Text: Däbe mɨnyi ddobae lelang abal ttoen da bogalle obo kuki tab e.
Translated_Text: If he broke the promise, that would be a very shameful thing.

Primary_Text: Bogo liglig eran.
Translated_Text: He is having sex.

Primary_Text: Ubi do me alignallo.
Translated_Text: They two had sex there.

Primary_Text: Ubi iddob me ddone bulignegnän.
Translated_Text: They will not be having sex at night.

Primary_Text: Bäne gullbe o mälla walle mae liglig ttoen de nangesnegneyo.
Translated_Text: Only have sexual relations with your husband or wife.

Primary_Text: Ngämo ine kutt a daeya yu da lɨklɨk eran.
Translated_Text: Fire is melting my water container.

Primary_Text: Llɨg obaene longgo de dändär, gongällbän a.
Translated_Text: I heard the kids making noise and woke up.

Primary_Text: Luluang lla da ai dan gagäll ud de bätramän.
Translated_Text: One who gossips can open the door to bad things.

Primary_Text: Ngäna dandärmällnegne mälla de ami bam daluneyo.
Translated_Text: I heard the women who were gossiping about you.

Primary_Text: Lla pättäpättäk a Meri bom dangnoeyän llädäd e.
Translated_Text: The short man asked Mary to marry him.

Primary_Text: Obo pallall lla da ddone ada kilikili gognegnän a tuk i gogäbnän.
Translated_Text: The people next to him were so happy and were jumping in the air.

Primary_Text: Ewatta ke gänya täräp me lla bombllo da wasnen anggan ttowamang ttoen tonton ikop e ddapall att?
Translated_Text: Why does the current generation beg to directly see miraculous things from heaven?

Primary_Text: Kemu bo llabun a gänyme a Malläm me dadeg.
Translated_Text: Kemu has relatives here and in Malam.

Primary_Text: Ddobag a bi dingismällalle täräb ma we, lla gulag a erame dag.
Translated_Text: The others return to the funeral home, where the crowd is.

Primary_Text: Särem a ollakan.
Translated_Text: Darkness collapses.

Primary_Text: Tätäm ttäle bun parga de bob a era dällekän.
Translated_Text: Yesterday the flood destroyed the Ttäle Bun bridge.

Primary_Text: Zon lla llɨg dan.
Translated_Text: John is a boy.

Primary_Text: Kwalde säre llama näkäp me gongosmällnän.
Translated_Text: Kwalde sadly returned unsatisfied.

Primary_Text: Däräng a llama näkäp me gongezänmällnän mama watta.
Translated_Text: The dog was coming out of the grass pile hesitantly.

Primary_Text: Ende eka da ngäma eka dan, Ingglis a llama eka dan.
Translated_Text: Ende is our (excl.) language; English is the language of other people.

Primary_Text: Llama ttoen da ge, be ngämi zäme ngämira dägageya ge ttoen de.
Translated_Text: This is another people's custom, but we are already doing this custom.

Primary_Text: llamäg a auseause
Translated_Text: old men and women

Primary_Text: Llamda da kumiye agan.
Translated_Text: The old man coughed.

Primary_Text: Ngämi llame deyareya mamoema.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) went hunting together.

Primary_Text: Ngämi llameae gobällne.
Translated_Text: We (excl.) were going together.

Primary_Text: Oba za sinen a llamealle mae.
Translated_Text: They shared their things together.

Primary_Text: Obo llan a ulle abal dan.
Translated_Text: His ear is very big.

Primary_Text: Oblle nyongo de dallendneyo.
Translated_Text: They were clearing the road for her.

Primary_Text: Bogo eka midd de dallendän.
Translated_Text: He clarified the meaning.

Primary_Text: Bongo mɨnyi llandräg ag?
Translated_Text: Are you going to listen?

Primary_Text: Abo llandräg ag Malläm att eka we.
Translated_Text: Expect some news from Malam.

Primary_Text: Daeya do llandär gognän.
Translated_Text: She was there listening.

Primary_Text: Ubi tätäm kaemne de llan donggoeyo.
Translated_Text: Yesterday, they listened intently to the bee.

Primary_Text: Gull a kab llatnenatt alle iatt kollba gäddnan ma dan.
Translated_Text: A net is a thing for catching fish, woven from twisted string.

Primary_Text: Gongosän ma we, däräng a wa kumuddäga lla da dokomän, ddia llatat e.
Translated_Text: He returned home, and took his dog and three men to track the deer.

Primary_Text: Kungge da llo ttam dädär ik i golläbän.
Translated_Text: The spider went under the dry tree leaves.

Primary_Text: Llɨg a bal de llädaenen eran.
Translated_Text: The boy is rolling the ball.

Primary_Text: Ubi dädär ulle de dalldaeyo auma ud de däpakeyo.
Translated_Text: They rolled a large rock and blocked the grave entrance.

Primary_Text: Ngäna walle we gäbän allan ddia llädäd e.
Translated_Text: I am jumping in the water to grab the deer.

Primary_Text: Ubi guspullän, be ubi obaoba gollädnegän.
Translated_Text: They fell, but they caught themselves.

Primary_Text: Iba pätt a ttongdae dan, ako kame ddone bällädeya.
Translated_Text: We (incl.) only have one body; we don't get another.

Primary_Text: Da ttongo lla da bäne baba bälle ten taosen mani bonttogän, ende bogo bällädän?
Translated_Text: If someone gave your dad ten thousand kina, what would he buy?

Primary_Text: Tu andred alle dällädeyo ttoe de.
Translated_Text: He bought the skin for two hundred.

Primary_Text: E mälla de ke bongo dälläd?
Translated_Text: Which woman did you marry?

Primary_Text: Da bongo lla tupi di nälläd, bongo mɨnyi llɨg kamebiag ag.
Translated_Text: If you marry the tall man, you will have many children.

Primary_Text: Angde obo täräp a ngäs e dällädalle, bogo mɨnyi do alle olle gogalle oba pate.
Translated_Text: When his time to return came, he would call out to them.

Primary_Text: Lläkäm a mamall zozoang dan.
Translated_Text: A mushroom goes rotten quickly.

Primary_Text: Sali yu di mermerae lläklläk eran.
Translated_Text: Sali is spreading the fire nicely.

Primary_Text: Gullem a sisri ag me towall llällallällamang yaran.
Translated_Text: This morning the snake came rustling the grass.

Primary_Text: Däbaballe ine llällam de dandärän.
Translated_Text: From there, he heard the water roaring.

Primary_Text: Golläntmenyän tämamae ngalen de.
Translated_Text: He told him everything.

Primary_Text: Ttam a ddobae lläng dag.
Translated_Text: The leaves are very sharp.

Primary_Text: Gudne giri da llängmeny dan.
Translated_Text: The old knife is dull.

Primary_Text: Mälla da dagaeya ttängäm e abällan mätta lläplläp e.
Translated_Text: The women went to the garden to dig the yams.

Primary_Text: Bogo biye kemibi dälläpnegalle.
Translated_Text: He used to harvest many taro roots.

Primary_Text: ttang lläpät, nying lläpät
Translated_Text: finger, toe

Primary_Text: Llɨg kälakäle, ttägäll käp de nälläteyoǃ
Translated_Text: Small children, get rid of these mumu stones!

Primary_Text: Bogo tuwelb lla de dällätmällnegän.
Translated_Text: He chose twelve men.

Primary_Text: ekaklle llätt e
Translated_Text: to the ends of the earth

Primary_Text: pazi llätt me
Translated_Text: at the end of the year

Primary_Text: Ge ttoen a llätt e gongttägän.
Translated_Text: This story is coming to an end.

Primary_Text: Oba abo dindu da dädme llätt gogon.
Translated_Text: Their race stopped there.

Primary_Text: Oba nag ttoen a llätt gogon.
